items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: naturally, naturally Bix knocked me out.

ctx.x: And the one who knocked me out the most as a saxophone player, see - I didn't hear any tenor players at that period that knocked me out more than Coleman, you understand what I mean, I didn't hear any - but that guy on the bass, Rollini, on the bass saxophone, every note he made was great. And naturally, naturally Bix knocked me out. And Miff Mole, I have a reason to say Miff Mole knocked me out, because I've heard a battle of three trombones right at Small's Paradise - Miff Mole, Jack Teagarden, and -
